# Camp items that buff Perception and where to find them in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 25, 2023
- 2 min read

Updated: Apr 11, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5d5cfc69f8984d6ea94b97d1db961aca~mv2.png)

Image credit: Mette & Cassi. Models: Old Hag43, Cafeloco735 and Purple69cat

The buffs you receive from these camp items will stack on top of buffs from food, chems, drinks, armour, etc.

You can not stack camp items that give the same buff ie Luck and Luck or Intelligence and Intelligence.

Camp item buffs will not stack on themselves.

__Boardwalk Bonanza Pinball Machine__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_15d400440aca49ae8f9ebde7b3d16112~mv2.jpg)

**Buff:**

+2 Perception

+2 Agility

**Lasts for:**

30 mintues

**Player animation:** 

Yes

**Obtained via:**

Atom Shop - 500 atoms

**Build Menu Location:**

Misc Tab

**Build Limit:**

4 per camp, shelter, or workshop.

Shares a build limit with the Alien Invasion Shooting Gallery, Armor Ace Laser Shooting Gallery, and the Boardwalk Bonanza Pinball Machine.

**Flamingo Units:**

1 Flamingo Unit

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_de577424e98c451482413ae2223b1c90~mv2.jpg)

Image credit: Mette & Cassi. Model: Purple69Cat

+2 Luck

**Lasts for:**

30 minutes

**Player animation:** 

Yes

**Obtained via:**

Players with a Bethesda.net account can opt in to email communications and receive a bonus C.A.M.P. item: Bowling Arcade Machine in Fallout 76

Link to claim here: https://freebundle.bethesda.net/en-US

**Build Menu Location:**

Floor Decor

**Build Limit:**

No limit

**Flamingo Units:**

1 Flamingo Unit
